section.title: Counting a project's open tasks
section.scenario: A project dashboard shows each project's open task count. The dashboard is read thousands of times an hour, and tasks are written only by a nightly import that runs in batches.
section.question: Both pieces show the same count. Which cost should this system pay, and which stated facts decide it?
section.piece_a:
class Project < ApplicationRecord
  # open_tasks_count is kept by TaskImport after each batch.
  def open_task_count
    open_tasks_count
  end
end

class TaskImport
  def finish_batch(project)
    project.update!(open_tasks_count: project.tasks.open.count)
  end
end
section.piece_b:
class Project < ApplicationRecord
  def open_task_count
    tasks.open.count
  end
end

class TaskImport
  def finish_batch(project)
    project.touch
  end
end
